title: Rational Canonical Form: Companion Matrix
description: Companion matrix definition and properties — the building block of rational canonical form (Frobenius normal form).

meta.author: Ferdinand Georg Frobenius (1878)
originalContributions: Companion matrix definition for monic polynomials
Proof that C(p) annihilates p (from Cayley-Hamilton + charpoly)
meta.assumptions: 0 axioms. 3 sorries (aeval, charpoly, minpoly — restructured without circular dependency). Orbit infrastructure fully proved.

overview.problemStatement: Define the companion matrix C(p) for a monic polynomial p and prove its key properties: charpoly(C(p)) = p and minpoly(C(p)) = p.
overview.text: The companion matrix is the fundamental building block of the rational canonical form. This file defines it and proves basic properties.
overview.proofStrategy: Direct definition using index arithmetic, with entry-level lemmas. The key theorems (charpoly = p, minpoly = p) are stated but require determinant computation and minimality arguments respectively.
keyInsights: Companion matrices are non-derogatory: minpoly = charpoly = p
The full RCF requires Smith Normal Form for F[X]-matrices (~800 lines) — main blocker
C(x-c) = [c] is the base case connecting eigenvalues to 1×1 companion blocks

crossReferences.relationship: Extends parent with concrete companion matrix construction
